Team — see attached redline with counsel notes. Summary of material positions and recommendations:

1) Transfers: Recommend using Redwood EU-US Transfer Addendum + SCCs where required. The customer's proposed alternate phrasing in Section 6 is broader than we can accept. Proposed counter: accept SCCs for controller-to-processor flows and our Addendum for processor-to-processor, with a short explanatory clause about onward transfers for subprocessors.

2) Subprocessors: We will provide the attached inventory and accept a 30-day prior notice for new subprocessors, not a prior approval requirement. For analytics vendors, we will add a named vendor category in the inventory export and confirm data processing activities (analytics only).

3) Liability: Customer increased cap to 6 months' fees. Recommend counter to 3x monthly fees or $1M, whichever is lower; if customer insists, escalate to revenue/finance for approval.

4) Evidence: SOC 2 (Type II) report access via secure link. I've created a temporary shared folder and added a readout. See drive link in the message below.

Execution recommendation: finalize redline, convert to clean exec copy, push to DocuSign. Signing order: BrightSpark -> Redwood. We can prefill signature blocks for execs.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
